name: uijin
about: uijin, the first campaign of Ten-Go (27 Oct 2026): the 4 pumps of the adaptive run left half done, a probe of the jumping lines below the lattice step, and the boiling window at 0.08 g

parts.about: the 4 pumps of the adaptive run on 5.2-5.6 g left half done (yzao, stopped 27 Oct 08:29), their missing orders only; the files keep the run's numbering J (x = 5.2 + J 0.004/1024 g)

the probe: 5.2085 g + h, h = 1.95 ug down to 0.48 ng by quarters, inside the 3.9 ug interval J 2176-2177 where lines at gamma ~ 7 g jump by 0.08 g; and 5.2085 g again at 80 digits (does precision move them?)
the precision probe: 5.2085 g, order 300, at 120 and 160 digits (the probe hpQ has it at 40 and 80)

the precision study: 5.2085 g at 240 and 320 digits (with hpQ and hpR, 40 to 320) and 250e at 80 (is certificate D sound at 80?); 5.206, 5.2025, 5.2135 g (the dust) and 5.4 g (a control) at 80 and 160; the boiling window, 12.83 and 35.23 g, at 80 and 160 (is 40 enough for hpK?)
order 400 at 80 digits at 5.2085 g (the dust) and 5.206 g (Sec. 33's order-400 test, there at 40 digits)
order 400 at 160 digits at 5.2085 g: with hpU (400e80) and hpR (300e160), the certificate 300/400 at two precisions
the certificate at 40 digits against 80 digits: below 5 g orders 150w/200e, from 6 g 250e/300e, each pump with its reference at 80 digits
the certificate 150w/200e at 40 digits against 200e80 at the bottom of close-0.004 (0.15, 0.5 g); 200e160 at 1.0 g, to check that its 200e80 is right where the certificate fails
the boiling window 12.51-42.91 g at 0.08 g (colours at 80 digits from 25 g, as in boil16)
the certificate at 80 digits (150w80/200e80 below 5 g, 250e80/300e80 above) against 160 digits, every 0.5 g of close-0.004 (0.5-4.5, 6.5-12.5 g)

the nursing program, round 1 (refining where Fig. 0QEGB's orange patches ask for pumps, code/meshfig.py REFINE=0.01): the tiny pairs of 12.28-12.41 g at 160 digits (300e160, against the filler's 300e80); 19-20 g to 0.001 g in its 6 flagged intervals (80 digits); the midpoints of the 30 flagged 0.08 g intervals of 12.51-19 and 20-21 g (40 digits); rounds 2-4 halve the intervals still flagged, to 0.005 g

the condensation program, round 1: 11.4-11.9 g refined where code/meshfig.py REFINE=0.01 flags the 80-digit pumps (the filler's lattice moved up front, not redone; midpoints off it, to 0.001 g), at 80 digits

the condensation program, round 2: 11.4-11.9 g refined where code/meshfig.py REFINE=0.01 flags the 80-digit pumps (the filler's lattice moved up front, not redone; midpoints off it, to 0.001 g), at 80 digits
the nursing program, round 2: the midpoints of the intervals of 12.51-19 and 20-21 g still flagged by code/meshfig.py REFINE=0.01 inside the 30 of round 1 (hpG), at 40 digits

refits.about: 27 Oct 20:30, Fabrice: 'let's go 80 digits then for the filler'. At 40 digits the 250/300 (and 150w/200e) certificate passes lines wrong by up to 0.26 g where gamma >= 6.5 g (0.5-1 g, 5.2-5.4 g, 6.5 g: hpQ-hpX); at 80 digits it was right at every pump tested. The pumps of hpT done or held at 40 digits keep their orders and are redone at 80 at the end (part hpTb)
